provenance: Hand-authored, derived search descriptors from the preserved source claims. These are index hints, not new factual evidence or a measured automatic extractor. Authored without editing the benchmark queries. The existing validation split has already been exposed in prior experiments.

retry.claim: Serialize retries with the per-order lock.

migration.claim: Apply migrations in sequence within a transaction.

credentials.claim: Keep credentials in the operating system keychain.

pagination.claim: Paginate the manager list using stable cursor ordering.

deletion.claim: Delete derived vectors when the source record is removed.

timeout.claim: Bound a subprocess deadline and reap it after termination.

formatting.claim: Format only the changed Rust modules.

cache.claim: Invalidate query cache entries after editing a claim.

worktree.claim: Track dirty worktree fingerprints for applicability.

provenance.claim: Link procedures to their source episode.

privacy.claim: Exclude restricted source paths before rendering context.

verification.claim: Match evidence to the exact content hash.

fallback.claim: Use lexical retrieval when the embedder fails.

generation.claim: Reject a delayed write with an obsolete generation.

locking.claim: Release the SQLite mutex before model execution.

retention.claim: Prune old episodes while retaining procedures.

deduplication.claim: Use scoped failure identity to consolidate lessons.

compaction.claim: Restore active memory IDs after history compaction.

isolation.claim: Retrieve only records in the current project.
